item.title: Peru: Israeli man dies after years of imprisonment
item.description:
A 62-year-old Israeli citizen, a resident of Petah Tikva, died in Peru after being imprisoned in the country for about three and a half years.
Upon receiving the report, ZAKA's international unit began working together with the Foreign Ministry, the family, and local authorities in Peru, with the aim of arranging all the necessary procedures and bringing his coffin for burial in Israel.

item.title: Liberman lays out coalition red lines ahead of Israeli elections
item.description: Yisrael Beytenu Chairman Avigdor Liberman sets coalition red lines, ruling out a minority government and demanding military or civilian service for all Israelis.

item.title: The hidden crisis facing haredi education
item.description: As government pushes core curriculum, severe teacher shortage prompting haredi leaders to confront deeper problem.

item.title: Joyous news: Widow of murdered soldier Elhanan Klein remarries
item.description: Hanan Breuer, who lost his wife Mor shortly after the birth of their son, and Hila Klein, the widow of Elhanan Klein, who was murdered in a terrorist attack, have built a new home together.

item.title: No single official can decide what Jewish children learn
item.description: Who gave one unelected official, Gali Baharav-Miara, this much power? Opinion.

item.title: Senior Iranian official: 'Iran is moving from defense to completely offensive'
item.description:
A senior Iranian official threatened that Iran has decided to shift its policy from defensive to "completely offensive," Reuters reported.
The official claimed that Iran has set a deadline of several weeks for the US to fully enforce the memorandum of understanding. "All Iranian entities are ready to escalate tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and the region if diplomacy fails. Iran's timetable will be conveyed to the US through intermediary countries. Iran will not wait for the US to continue its naval blockade forever."

item.title: 7 Flights, 11 Days in Israel, or $18,000 Cash, One Ticket
item.description: For the 31st year, one Chicago high school's raffle sends a family to Yerushalayim for Sukkos; drawing September 3rd.

item.title: How Hamas outsmarted the West’s media, universities and NGOs
item.description: UN Rapporteur Albanese said the death toll in Gaza was 680,000 (it’s 70,000 including terrorists), including 380,000 infants under five. When told there were only 341,790 children under five in Gaza to begin with, Albanese said she lied deliberately because “it had the effect I wanted".

item.title: Miri Regev accuses: 'El Al decided to try to take me down'
item.description: Transportation Minister Miri Regev claims that the El Al workers’ committee is working against her in the Likud primaries.

item.title: Israeli study reveals: Attention can regulate acute inflammation in humans
item.description: Directing attention toward bodily sensations reduces inflammation, accelerates recovery in healthy volunteers, new study shows.

item.title: Trump on Israeli elections: I should stay out, but may endorse someone

item.title: Teshuvah and improving the world
item.description: The power of teshuvah is not limited, it encompasses every domain of life, that of the individual and that of civilization as a whole.

item.title: Houthis claim to have fired ballistic missiles at Saudi ships in Bab al-Mandeb Strait
item.description: The Houthi military spokesman, Yahya Saree, confirmed that the rebel organization attacked a Saudi naval landing ship and four other military boats in the Bab al-Mandeb Strait with ballistic missiles.

item.description: US President Donald Trump tells Fox News that he will bomb Oman if they 'get in the way,' insists Hamas will disarm.

item.title: Shas officials jump ship

item.title: 40 minutes of fear: Jews attacked in Barcelona
item.description: Seven Jewish tourists from France were attacked by hundreds at the port of Barcelona and subjected to 40 minutes of curses, spitting, and chants against Jews and Israel.

item.title: Public urged to pray for beloved rabbi
item.description: Family calls on the public to pray and increase Torah study and good deeds for Rabbi Shalom Pinchas Burstein. 'He is in need of great Heavenly mercy.'

item.title: Likud primaries: The battle heats up, Gotliv claims missing voting slips
item.description: 14,307 Likud members already exercised their right to vote in Likud primaries. Gotliv claims ballots without her name, Yoni Yosef withdraws candidacy, and Netanyahu expresses support for Osnat Zohar.

item.title: 80 cattle seized after disrupting IDF training
